meta.name: browser-automation
meta.description: Local Python-based browser automation toolkit using Playwright. Provides command-line tools for navigating, interacting with, and testing web applications without using MCP protocols. Supports clicking, typing, hovering, screenshots, content extraction, and JavaScript execution.
